description: This file is a shell script used for testing internationalization (i18n) commit and log output encodings in a Git project. It includes setup procedures, tests for various character encoding scenarios, and logic to verify encoding handling, especially in commit messages.

methods.name: compare_with
methods.description: Compares the output of 'git show' with a specified file, optionally applying encoding conversion to UTF-8.

methods.name: test_commit_autosquash_flags
methods.description: Automates testing of git commit with --fixup or --squash flags across different encodings.

methods.name: test_commit_autosquash_multi_encoding
methods.description: Tests rebasing commits with different encodings and autosquash options, verifying correct encoding conversion.
